summary: Toggle mode is added to the existing ZestButton as an optional `zest.toggleOptions` object (pressed, defaultPressed, onPressedChange, checkPosition). Nothing is restructured. The project is flat (UI/, Styles/, __tests__/, documentation/), so this design follows that layout rather than the generic components/<Component>/ layout. A new hook, UI/hooks/useToggleState.ts, owns the on/off value: controlled when `pressed` is given, otherwise self-managed from `defaultPressed`. ZestButton gets new additive code only: the destructured toggleOptions, a new `handleToggleClick` that sits beside handleClick/handleConfirmClick, a small ToggleCheck svg component placed next to AnimatedCheckmark, and a conditional render of the check at the chosen end. The existing handlers keep their bodies; the new handler is wired into the button's onClick only when toggleOptions is present. Without toggleOptions, no aria-pressed attribute, no extra class and no extra element is rendered, so non-toggle markup is byte-identical (risk 1). The toggle check is a distinct element (its own class and a pop/draw animation, in the start/end slot and tied to the pressed state), separate from the busy/success checkmark that only appears in the left icon slot after an async action (risk 2). Confirmation: the flip happens inside the post-confirm path, so it happens only after the user confirms. Disabled or busy: the button element is already disabled, so clicks never reach the handler and the state is only displayed. Dropdown: only the main button gets aria-pressed and the toggle handler; ZestDropdownMenu is untouched. Styles: CSS Modules additions only, using the existing theme variables and the .force-dark/.force-light classes. A `.toggleOn` pressed look (tinted/filled background plus inset shadow) is defined per buttonStyle (solid/outline/text/dashed) and variant, and the focus ring is visible in both states. Check animations are inside a new prefers-reduced-motion block. Sizes are in rem, mobile first. The public surface changes by types only, since UI/index.ts already does `export * from './ZestButton'`: new exported types `ToggleOptions` and `ToggleCheckPosition` ('start' | 'end'), and a new optional `toggleOptions?: ToggleOptions` on ZestCustomProps. No export is removed or changed, so this is not a breaking change; the version is bumped as a minor (1.6.0) and breaking-changes.md records an 'additive, no breaking changes' note. Cost: no new dependency, peer dependency or asset (the check is an inline svg like AnimatedCheckmark). One useState for the self-managed value and no timers or listeners, so nothing is left running after unmount. Toggling re-renders only this button. Work per render is O(1), independent of data size. Bundle growth is small (about 1 KB with CSS); the project has no .size-limit.json, so no budget is touched. The package.json build setup, rollup config, exports map and peer dependencies are not changed, so the build-externalization and peer-dependency tests stay valid. Tests: first, characterization tests pin current non-toggle behaviour (markup has no aria-pressed, class list, click, disabled, confirm and dropdown flows). Then new toggle tests are written failing-first, ending with the full suite run.
